description_en: This god-house (dyaḥchẽ) of Kamalādī Gaṇeśa is the place where the palanquin procession the deity is taken out every year on the full moon day of Caitra.Located at Tyaḥra, Kaḥmilāchi in Kathmandu, this five-storied residence of Kamalādī Gaṇeśa appears like a private house at first glance. While Kamalādī Gaṇeśa Mandira in Kamalādī, Kathmandu is the main temple of this deity, this building is his residence where various items needed for his annual procession are also stored. The fourth floor of this temple houses Gaṇeśa statues made of silver, brass, and copper. The ground floor of this south-facingdyaḥchẽhas been rented out to a spice shop. The first floor has three latticed windows with the central one adorned with a woodentoraṇafeaturing a Gaṇeśa figure as its central deity. Other details of thedyaḥchẽ’s interiors are unclear, as the building was not accessible for this documentation.There are no historical records of thedyaḥchẽ’s initial construction. The religious trust of the Maharjanas associated with the Kamalādī Gaṇeśa built a temple for the deity in 1750 CE (NS 870) (Purscha 1975, p. 99). Kamalādī Gaṇeśa, however, may have been established long before that as a small shrine. The Kamalādī Gaṇeśa Dyaḥchẽ was probably built around the same time the main shrine of the deity was established. The traditional architecture of thedyaḥchẽwas not adopted while the building was reconstructed into a modern building in 1993 CE (VS 2050) after it fell into poor state of repair (guthimember, Maharjana, male, age 60). The ground floor of thedayḥchẽhas now (January 2025) been rented out to financially support the daily and periodic rituals of Kamalādī Gaṇeśa, who is also revered as Śveta Gaṇeśa.The Maharjanas of Jamal serve as the hereditary priests and caretakers (dyaḥpāḥlāḥ) of the Kamalādī Gaṇeśa temple. The Kamalādī Gaṇeśa Jamaḥmi Guthi, a religious trust managed by them, oversees all socio-cultural activities related to the deity. Annually, on the full moon day of Caitra, the Kamalādī Gaṇeśa procession takes place. The day before, the Gaṇeśa statue is ceremoniously carried from thedyaḥchẽon a palanquin to his temple in Kamalādī. Throughout the following day, the statue receives special worship at the temple. A unique rice dish calledmaraḥjā, prepared at thedyaḥchẽ, is also brought to the temple for offering to the trust members. The next day, the 1st of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha, the Gaṇeśa palanquin is paraded through the city. Locals offer their prayers to the deity during this procession, after which the statue is returned to thedyaḥchẽ. On the 2nd of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha, the trust members gather at thedyaḥchẽfor a celebratory feast known astvāḥbhvay. This day also marks the transition of temple caretaking responsibilities. The year's income and expenditure are reviewed, and the next caretaker assumes their duties for the coming year.On the 14th of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, special worship is offered to Nāsaḥdyaḥ, the deity of music and charm, residing within thedyaḥchẽ. This is followed by a festive meal enjoyed by the trust members (guthimember, Maharjana, male, age 60).
description_ne: काठमाडौ उपत्यकाका प्रसिद्ध गणेशहरूमध्ये एक मानिने कमलादी गणेशको यस द्य:छेँबाट चैत्र शुक्ल पूर्णिमाका दिन कमलादी गणेशको खटजात्रा निकालिन्छ ।काठमाडौंको त्य:र, कःमिलाछिमा अवस्थित यस द्य:छेँ पाँच तलाको रहेको छ । हेर्दा व्यक्तिगत घर जस्तो देखिने यस द्य:छेँको चौथौ तलामा गणेश मूर्तिहरू स्थापना गरिएका छन् । यहाँ चाँदी, पीतल र तामाको गरी तीनवटा गणेश मूर्तिहरू रहेका छन् । दक्षिणाभिमुख यस द्य:छेँको भुइँतलामा मसला पसल रहेको छ । द्य:छेँको पहिलो तलामा तीनवटा आँखीझ्यालहरू रहेका छन् । बीचको झ्यालमाथि केन्द्रमा गणेश कुँदिएको काठको तोरण राखिएको छ ।यस द्य:छेँलाई कसले र कहिले निर्माण गर्‍यो भन्ने तथ्यको कुनै अभिलेख प्राप्त छैन । नेसं ८७० (सन् १७५०) मा महर्जन गुठीका गुठीयारहरूले कमलादी गणेशमा देवल बनाई छाना राखेको थियो (Purscha 1975, p. 99) । सम्भवतः देवल बनाउनुअघि नै कमलादी गणेश स्थापना भैसकेको थियो । गणेशको स्थापनासंगै यस द्य:छेँको पनि निर्माण त्यहि समयमा भएको अनुमान लगाउन सकिन्छ । पुरानो शैलीको घर जीर्ण भएपछि विसं २०५० (सन् १९९३) मा आधुनिक शैलीमा पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो (guthimember, Maharjana, male, age 60) । श्वेतगणेशका रूपमा पनि पुजिने कमलादी गणेशको दैनिक र विभिन्न पूजाआजाका लागि आर्थिक सहयोग हुने गरी करिब दश वर्षदेखि द्यःछेँको भुईँ तला भाडामा दिइएको छ ।जमलका महर्जनहरू कमलादी गणेशको पुजारी र द्य:पाला हुन् । ‘कमलादी गणेश जम:मि गुठी’ अन्तर्गत यहाँका गतिविधि हुँदै आइरहेका छन् । चैत शुक्ल पूर्णिमा अर्थात्ल्हुति पुन्हिका दिन कमलादी गणेशको जात्रा गर्ने चलन छ । पूर्णिमाको अघिल्लो दिन गणेश मूर्तिलाई खटमा राखी यहाँबाट कमलादी गणेश मन्दिरमा लगिन्छ । पूर्णिमाको दिनभरि गणेशलाई मन्दिरमा स्थापना गरी पूजा गरिन्छ र सोहि दिन द्य:छेँबाट तयार पारिएकोमर:जा(मल:जा) गुठी सदस्यहरूलाई मन्दिरमा राखी खुवाइन्छ । पूर्णिमाको भोलिपल्ट (वैशाख कृष्ण प्रतिपदा) मन्दिरबाट खट उठाई जात्रा गर्दै र पूजा थाप्दै द्य:छेँ ल्याइन्छ । वैशाख कृष्ण द्वितीयामात्वा:भ्वय्भनी गुठी सदस्यहरू सबै मिली यहाँ बसी भोज खाने परम्परा रहेको छ । सोहि दिन द्य:पाःलाः परिवर्तन गर्ने र एक वर्ष भरीको आर्थिक हिसाबको आन्तरिक लेखा परिक्षण गरी नयाँ द्य:पाःलाःहरूलाई जिम्मेवारी हस्तान्तरण गर्ने कार्य पनि गरिन्छ । यस बाहेक बालाच:ह्रय् (मार्ग कृष्ण चतुर्दशी) को दिन यहाँ नास:द्य:को पूजा-आराधना गरी भोज खाने परम्परा पनि रहेको छ (guthimember, Maharjana, male, age 60) ।

historical_events.event_description: Thedyaḥchẽwas reconstructed into a modern building after it fell into poor state of repair, without adopting its traditional architecture.
